prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for the existing Snowcap desktop pet.
Input image 1 is the exact character identity and pixel style reference, not a UI design.
Create a NEW supplementary movement atlas for this SAME character: chibi pink twin-tail girl with bright orange star eyes, tiny gold hair ornaments and pastel blue clip, white/lilac clothes, short purple scarf/cape, holding the SAME small black cat with orange eyes, SAME tiny white spotted snow-leopard cub and blue/pink bow balanced on her head. Preserve exact proportions, costume, colors, crisp dark pixel outlines and small-pixel rendering. Do not redesign or make a bigger head, glossy 3D or vector art.
Canvas 1536x1664 px, EXACTLY 8 equal columns and 8 equal rows, 64 cells, each cell 192x208. No drawn grid, no labels, no words. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard or ground shadow.
Each cell contains one whole sprite independently centered. Same character scale in every cell, approximately 152 pixels wide by 190 pixels tall, with the feet baseline at y=200 of each cell, leave 6px clear alpha margin on every cell edge. Never touch or overlap adjacent cells.
Animation sequence left to right is one continuous 8-frame walk cycle, with small coherent consecutive changes, foot contact -> down -> passing -> up -> opposite contact -> down -> passing -> up. Feet alternate and cloth, twin tails and head cub follow with subtle secondary motion. No random poses. Frame 8 should flow into frame 1. Hold the cat continuously.
Rows TOP TO BOTTOM, exact order:
1 walking toward screen-right/east, gentle right-facing three-quarter profile.
2 walking toward screen-left/west, gentle left-facing three-quarter profile.
3 walking upward/north, rear three-quarter view, show pink twin tails and purple back cape, cat held in front partly occluded.
4 walking downward/south, front-facing toward viewer.
5 walking up-right/northeast, rear-right three-quarter.
6 walking up-left/northwest, rear-left three-quarter.
7 walking down-right/southeast, front-right three-quarter.
8 walking down-left/southwest, front-left three-quarter.
Consistent planted foot baseline, small vertical head bob maximum 3px, no per-frame scale drift. Character identity must remain recognizable in back view. Preserve every accessory. The original idle/actions will remain in use, so match the reference closely.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: supplementary transparent animation atlas for Snowcap / Ameath desktop pet.
Image 1 is the original character identity and pixel-style reference. Image 2 is the matching new eight-direction movement atlas. Create the SAME character and matching crisp pixel-art outlines, proportions and palette; this sheet must connect smoothly to both reference assets. Pink twin-tail girl, orange star eyes, gold hair ornaments and blue hair clip, white/lilac outfit and short purple cape, holding the SAME black orange-eyed cat at all times, with the SAME tiny white snow-leopard cub and pastel bow sitting on her head.
Create ONLY an evenly tiled sprite sheet, no scene or UI, no labels or grid lines. Genuine transparent RGBA background; no opaque background, checkerboard, text, ground or shadow.
EXACTLY 8 equal columns and 4 equal rows, all cells occupied. Intended canvas 1536x832 with 192x208 cells. Each whole sprite centered with a consistent 190px standing height and baseline at y=200 of its cell. At least 6px alpha padding around every cell. Equal character scale throughout, never clip ears/hair/feet or cross a cell.
Rows top to bottom:
ROW 1 IDLE, eight sequential frames: neutral original front-facing stance, gentle breathing, tiny hair/cub settling, one soft blink, then return exactly to neutral. Not eight random expressions. Frame 8 blends into frame 1.
ROW 2 WAVE, eight sequential frames: neutral stance; paw-hand starting to lift; half-raised; fully raised; small warm wave left; small wave right; hand lowering; same neutral stance. Cat stays held with other arm. The head cub bobs minimally.
ROW 3 JUMP, eight sequential frames: neutral; soft anticipation crouch; push-off; rise; apex with feet 14px higher; descend; soft bent-knee landing with hair/cape follow-through; same neutral stance. Do not scale the body while jumping. Keep the entire action inside each cell.
ROW 4 TURN-IN-PLACE poses: eight standing views rotating gradually clockwise around a fixed foot anchor. Column 1 faces DOWN/front toward viewer, 2 DOWN-RIGHT/front-right three-quarter, 3 RIGHT profile, 4 UP-RIGHT/rear-right three-quarter, 5 UP/rear, 6 UP-LEFT/rear-left three-quarter, 7 LEFT profile, 8 DOWN-LEFT/front-left three-quarter. Same standing pose, no walking or jumping on row4. In back views the cat remains held in front and is partly hidden; show pink twin tails and purple back cape. These 8 poses will be played forwards or backwards for smooth turns.
Preserve original anatomy and accessory details. Consecutive animation frames must have small coherent differences and neutral endpoints. Avoid inconsistent head size, repeated identical walk feet, glows, blurry edges, glossy/vector/3D render or random extra animals.
